Source: A 26-year-old woman presents to the emergency department with 1 day of vaginal bleeding and lower abdominal pain.
Leukocyte count: 6,000/mm^3 Hemoglobin: 9.5 g/dL Her last menstrual period was 7 weeks ago.
Serum beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG): 2,700 IU/L Physical examination is notable for diffuse abdominal tenderness upon palpation.
She uses a copper intrauterine device and is in a monogamous relationship.
Pelvic examination demonstrates uterine and adnexal tenderness and uterine bleeding.
She denies any recent abdominal or vaginal trauma.
